page.layout: One page of text: title lines centred at top, a Greek verse dedication with a woodcut initial in the middle, a red name line, and a catchword at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.l: In Apostolorum Acta, à summo, eruditione
ΝΥ'ΚΤΑ ΜΕΤ' Ο'ΡΦΝΑΙ'ΗΝ Ω'Σ ΤΡΟΧΟ'Σ Ἡ'ΕΛΙΟΤ,
· ΦΗΜΙ' ΔΕ' ΚΑΙ' ΤΑΥ̃ΤΗΝ ΠΡᾶΞΙΝ, ΑΠΟΣΤΟ-

page.notes: The woodcut initial at the start of the Greek verse is ornamental; its letter is read as Τ and is doubtful. The Greek accents and breathings are copied as far as the scan shows them and may be imperfect. The red lines (title name and signature) are printed in red.
